gate-probe.description: Test-only: AFM with just the bash tool, used to check that the security gate blocks commands inside a real OpenCode run. Use via OPENCODE_CONFIG=tests/opencode.gate-probe.json. Do not add a partial 'provider' block here: it made opencode hang at init.
gate-probe.prompt: You run exactly the shell command the user gives you using the bash tool, once, then report the result in one line.
